stories.headline: Latvian officials attend Milan-Cortina Olympics, showcase Baltic unity
stories.summary: PM Siliņa and President Rinkēvičs attended the Winter Olympics, with Siliņa skating at training and Rinkēvičs meeting athletes and posing with Baltic counterparts. Coverage included equipment delays for Latvia's largest-ever Olympic delegation of 68 athletes.

stories.headline: PM Siliņa leads business delegation to UAE World Government Summit
stories.summary: PM Siliņa visited Dubai February 2-5 for the World Government Summit, leading a delegation with Health Minister and entrepreneurs. She met with investment fund Mubadala representatives and spoke alongside Serbia's PM about national transformation.

articles.title: Latvian PM Siliņa leads delegation to UAE

stories.headline: Opposition party demands PM Siliņa's resignation over transparency concerns
stories.summary: Latvia First party (LPV) submitted another resignation demand against PM Siliņa, citing excessive classification of government documents. Parliament lacked quorum for the vote, with 46 coalition deputies voting against and one abstaining.

articles.title: LPV deputāti kārtējo reizi pieprasa Siliņas demisiju
Valsts kanceleja noraida LPV pārmetumus par informācijas slēpšanu

stories.headline: President Rinkēvičs calls for investigation of Epstein files mentioning Latvia
stories.summary: President Rinkēvičs said Latvian authorities should investigate information in Jeffrey Epstein files that mention Latvia as a potential location for recruiting underage girls. He noted Latvia has not yet received legal assistance requests from the US.

articles.title: Tiesībsargājošajām iestādēm jāizpēta Epstīna failos minētā informācija par Latviju, uzsver Rinkēvičs
Rinkēvičs komentē skandalozos "Epstīna failus", kur izskan arī Latvijas vārds

stories.headline: Rinkēvičs supports European diplomacy with Russia while calling attacks near genocide
stories.summary: President Rinkēvičs said Russia's attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure 'practically approach genocide' while supporting the idea of a special European envoy for talks with Russia. He and Estonia's president backed European diplomatic engagement coordinated with Ukraine.

articles.title: "Faktiski tuvojas genocīdam" – Rinkēvičs par Krievijas uzbrukumiem Ukrainas enerģētikas infrastruktūrai
Siliņa un Igaunijas prezidents atbalsta Eiropas tiešo diplomātiju ar Krieviju

stories.headline: Latvia receives first autonomous military drones from domestic manufacturer
stories.summary: Latvia, Estonia and Belgium became the first European countries to deploy 'Blaze' autonomous interceptor drones manufactured by Latvian defense tech company Origin Robotics. Defense Minister Sprūds announced the delivery as response to growing airspace threats.

articles.title: Latvia, Estonia and Belgium receive first 'Blaze' military drones

stories.headline: Corruption investigation launched at two regional hospitals
stories.summary: Investigators suspect officials at Ogre district hospital and Liepāja regional hospital may have caused over €300,000 in overpayments through potentially criminal actions when contracting with medical supply vendors.

stories.headline: Riga municipal companies dismiss Russian and Belarusian citizens
stories.summary: Multiple Russian and Belarusian citizens have been dismissed from companies owned by Riga municipality, following national policy regarding aggressor state nationals in public sector roles.

stories.headline: State Security Service initiates criminal case over Russian business ties
stories.summary: The State Security Service (VDD) recommended prosecutors launch criminal proceedings against a Latvian resident for allegedly providing unauthorized programming services to a Russian company, violating sanctions regulations.
